nodes.label: Check the change against the rule book

metadata.comment: checkChange is the same text as scripts/gala/rows.js (script files don't run in cloud functions yet); tests/rows-guard.test.mjs fails if they differ. A cloud function runs as system, so this check is the only thing between a request and the database.

nodes.label: Save it, replacing this row's last change

metadata.comment: Upsert on key (table:rowId): one record per changed row, so the page always sends the row's whole change, not one field.
